spectrum_csv_real_imag: raw SI spectrum before 8-10 mHz filter
frequency_filter: unity below 8 mHz; cosine 8-10 mHz; zero at and above 10 mHz
sampling_scope: first requested angular points from the complete 2L grid crossed with every provided native radial node; diagnostic subset, not the full global kernel
kernel_angular_grid: 2*lmax+1 Gauss-Legendre colatitudes and FastFFTSize(4*lmax+1) uniform longitudes, theta-major then longitude; direct coordinates without SphericalGrid/Wigner storage
kernel_interface_side_rule: native q=0 maps Side::Above; q=NN-1 maps Side::Below when at a model interface
kernel_memory_estimate_method: 80 bytes per angular point for KernelPlace, frame geometry, and conservative alignment/block overhead; 6-component 8-order strain tables per radial point and degree; 3x the 64-place spin/Legendre workspace; local and scratch-update tiles; 13-double transform block; node material cache; 512 MiB fixed reserve; full accumulator and output are positioned-I/O disk files
kernel_binary_layout: float64 native endian; angle-major, then radial node, then A,C,F,L,N parameter; v6 layout
